gui.help_context_text:
The context limit is the maximum amount of text the AI can process at once.

By default, DocFuse estimates the volume using the formula:
  tokens = UTF-8 bytes / 4
  with a safety margin of +15%.
This generic counter does not depend on any provider.

You can pick a precise counting engine (e.g. Mistral) under
"Counting precision" for a real token count, computed locally
with no network connection.

If the total exceeds the limit, generation is blocked.
You can increase the limit if your AI allows it
(e.g., 200,000 for Claude, 128,000 for GPT-4o).
